changes.title: Tables stay open through display recreation
changes.text: The UIMSD Tables chooser now restores exactly once after Android recreates the active statistics scene, including repeated display-setting or system-font rebuilds. Its selected table, query and callback stay intact; no run history, score, save, rules, combat or content behavior changes.

changes.title: Retain TEST341 evidence and verify the Tables restorer
changes.text: Preserve the owner-only TEST341 publication and all prior fallbacks. A core source guard and the existing Android restoration scenario cover the exact Tables picker through two rebuilds and a restored selection. Retain acceptance, visual, publication, documentation-checkpoint and history evidence; require complete core, API34, API36, display, resource, signing and immediate-predecessor history gates before any new private candidate is named.

commentary: Preserve every compiled TEST341 history TSV and append exactly one new record.
